sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the score reflects how stretched or depressed market expectations are heading into the print. The document notes that consensus EPS was revised up 0.2% in the prior 30 days, indicating a slightly elevated bar. More importantly, it flags tariff-driven cost pressure as the key risk, with CEO Doug McMillon noting retailers are running out of pre-tariff cheaper inventory and new shipments costing more. This suggests a demanding setup with a real cost headwind, raising the risk of a negative surprise even if results are decent. The score is set at -0.15, just below the HOLD band, reflecting a mildly stretched expectation with a notable risk factor.
